## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.9
**Improvements** - **Center window (⌃⌥C)** now resizes the window to a quarter of the screen and centers it, matching what Focus Center recognizes. - **Blackout Built-in Display** now greys out with an explanation when no external display is connected (it needs one to mirror to), and no longer half-enables in that case. - **Audio Mixer** app rows keep a stable order between menu opens instead of shuffling by recent activity, and the output-device name no longer clips. - **More translations** — the "control Finder" and location permission prompts, plus new menu text, are now localized in every supported language.
